source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: As another possible back-end feature, could we have an interactive gallery that viewers are able to scroll through?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The homepage looks great, and I also like the current gallery design. For the services page, could each listed service have a corresponding image—for example, photos, twilights, floor plans, and 3D views? Because this is primarily a photography business, every page should be highly visual and image-focused.

Please remove the monthly and annual tabs from the services page because all pricing is one-time only. For the bundles, could we have four spaces instead of 3? I would also like a large diagram showing every individual service we offer. Full pricing transparency is important so customers can see the exact breakdown and add individual items when needed. I have attached a PDF containing all items that must be included; most are categorized by both price and property square footage.

The main gallery only needs tabs for photos, twilights, videos, floor plans, and 3d tour. A smaller area could cover other photography since we sometimes accept one-off clients. During development of the actual website, could the gallery items also receive hover animations? Overall, the pages look excellent!

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text:
Priya,

Your latest feedback has now been applied to the website design. Please review the complete updated version at the link below and share your thoughts.

<https://design.silverpine-media.example/proto/H7k2Lm9Qv4R8sT3Nx6Wp1Z/Silver-Pine-Media---Website-Concept?node-id=72-216&page-id=4%3A1&starting-point-node-id=72%3A216>

Thank you!

execution.observed_behavior: The agency reports that the requested gallery design and organization revisions were applied to the updated website design.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Overall, this is looking great. I do have a couple of things to flag: I think there may be a gallery glitch, and I’ve recorded the clip below to demonstrate it.

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text:
Priya,

The gallery issue has now been resolved, and all website images have been updated.

When you have a chance, please review the changes and tell me whether anything else is needed.

Thank you!

execution.observed_behavior: The agency reports that the gallery issue has been resolved.

routing_warnings.description: The request for gallery-item hover animations belongs to the independent gallery hover-effects Requirement.
The request to disable hover animations on mobile belongs to the gallery hover-effects Requirement.
The request to avoid horizontal scrolling in the mobile pricing sheet belongs to the mobile pricing-table Requirement.
The request to correct homepage button destinations belongs to the homepage navigation-links Requirement.
Video support within the gallery is independently represented by the gallery video-integration Requirement.
Removing the homepage video while retaining the gallery video changes the homepage video-integration Requirement, not gallery browsing and organization.
